about: Landmarks left out of locations.json after their pictures were looked at, by placement (map, wmo: wmo_placement unique_id), so a new run of scripts/pick.ts keeps them out and fills their zone from the next best. by: draft (proposed from the contact sheets, waiting on the user eye pass), user (the draft confirmed by the user's eye pass of 30 October, the user's own drop, or one following from it unrendered), or render (it never rendered; none left since the renderer fetches the files the client lacks). Near-duplicates (the same model or the same name twice in a zone) are not listed: the picker keeps one of each (src/landmarks.ts choose). empty: a zone left with no picture on purpose, with why (test/locations.test.ts refuses any other).
